# apipbx_recording (Resource)

A stored announcement. The audio must be a WAV file of 16-bit PCM, mono, 8000 Hz. Import is not supported: the audio cannot be read back into the configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String) The WAV file, base64 encoded: filebase64("welcome.wav"). Convert other audio with ffmpeg -i in.mp3 -ar 8000 -ac 1 -c:a pcm_s16le out.wav.
- `name` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `duration_seconds` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the stored WAV file.
